$comment: Card art for the Stargate Atlantis custom pack (src/data/custom/atlantis.json): one source per `art` key. `enwiki:` files are the non-free stills each character's Wikipedia article uses; `tmdb:` ids are series stills and promotional images from TMDB (show 2290). Sheppard's still is the TMDB copy of the season 4 cast photo that Wikipedia captions left to right, cropped to the third figure. Everything is local use only: `npx tsx tools/custom/render-cards.ts atlantis` fetches into vendor/custom/ and renders into public/custom/. Cards with `likeness: false` are painted from their description. Drop your own image as vendor/custom/atlantis/override/<key>.<jpg|png|webp> to replace one.
palette: Atlantis's look — ocean blues and the teal glow of Ancient technology, warm amber stained glass in the gate room, cold grey-green organic Wraith ships; no Star Trek purple

sheppard.subject: Lt. Col. John Sheppard, the expedition's military commander: messy dark hair, a lopsided confident half-smile, a black uniform shirt with the Atlantis expedition patch on the shoulder, a P90 on a sling, the glowing Stargate behind him
sheppard.notes: Sheppard faces the viewer, his face large, well lit and in sharp focus

atlantis.subject: the Ancient city-ship Atlantis floating on a blue ocean: a snowflake of piers around tall elegant spires, the central tower lit from within, a faint shimmering shield dome rising over it

weir.subject: Dr. Elizabeth Weir, the expedition's civilian leader and a diplomat: short dark hair, a burgundy wrap top, a calm and resolute expression, the stained-glass windows of the Atlantis control room behind her

keller.subject: Dr. Jennifer Keller, Atlantis's young chief medical officer: long light-brown hair, a dark expedition jacket with a medical patch, a kind but determined look, the infirmary's soft blue light behind her

carter.subject: Col. Samantha Carter, astrophysicist and commander of Atlantis in its fourth year: short blond hair, a black leather jacket over a dark uniform, a sharp, focused expression, the glowing Stargate behind her
carter.notes: Carter faces the viewer, her face large, well lit and in sharp focus (the still is small: keep the likeness, add detail)

todd.subject: a Wraith commander and uneasy ally: pale grey-green skin, long white hair, slitted yellow-green eyes, a dark star-shaped tattoo spreading around his left eye, a short goatee, a long black leather coat, one clawed hand raised to show the feeding slit in his palm, the dim ribbed organic corridor of a hive ship behind him

warship.subject: an Ancient warship: a long, slender grey hull like a stretched arrowhead with blue-lit seams and two forward prongs, launching a swarm of glowing yellow drone weapons toward an organic Wraith hive ship in deep space

chair.subject: the Ancient control chair: a reclining throne-like seat on a round dais, its armrests and base glowing pale blue as it comes alive, a swarm of golden drone weapons spiralling up out of the dark chamber around it
chair.notes: the chair is empty; it is the subject, not a person

asuras.subject: Asuras, the Asurans' homeworld: a gleaming, sterile copy of an Ancient city of spires under a cold silver sky, every surface too perfect, a faint sheen of nanites in the air

janus-lab.subject: a hidden Ancient laboratory: a dim stone-and-metal room full of glowing teal consoles and holographic displays, half-finished experiments on the benches, and in the middle a small gate ship fitted with a strange time-travel device

ronon.subject: Ronon Dex, a Satedan warrior and former Runner: long dreadlocks, a sleeveless brown leather vest, arms crossed, a stern watchful look, his heavy energy pistol on his hip, the gate room behind him

beckett.subject: Dr. Carson Beckett, the expedition's Scottish doctor and geneticist: short dark hair, a warm friendly smile, a tan and grey expedition jacket with a Scottish flag patch, a syringe of gene therapy in hand, the infirmary behind him

daedalus.subject: the Daedalus, a BC-304 battlecruiser from home: a long, boxy grey hull with two forward flight-deck pods and a tall rear tower, its engines glowing as it descends toward the lit spires of Atlantis at night

zpm.subject: a ZPM, an Ancient zero point module: a tall faceted crystal cylinder glowing warm amber-orange from within, seated in a metal pedestal, light spilling across a dark ruin
zpm.notes: the ZPM alone is the subject; leave out the people around it

hive-ship.subject: a Wraith hive ship: a vast dark organic vessel shaped like a ribbed manta, its hull like grown bone and bark, darts swarming from it, looming over a blue planet

naquadah.subject: a naquadah generator: a compact, rugged metal power unit with a glowing core visible through a vent, cables running from it, set up on a workbench in an Atlantis lab with the city's lights behind

new-arrivals.subject: new members of the expedition stepping out of the Stargate's shimmering blue event horizon into the Atlantis gate room and walking toward the viewer with packs and supply cases, the city's tall angled pillars and windows around the gate, the event horizon rippling behind them
new-arrivals.notes: they come out of the gate toward the viewer, small figures with no recognisable faces; this is the gate room of Atlantis in the Pegasus galaxy, not the gate room back home

database.subject: the Ancient database: a vast holographic display of glowing symbols, star maps and gate addresses filling a dark room in Atlantis, a single console lit in teal at its centre

culling.subject: a Wraith culling: a sleek purple-grey Wraith dart sweeping low over a green meadow, its bright beam sweeping the ground and dissolving the people caught in it
culling.notes: the people are small, distant figures

mainland.subject: the Athosian settlement on the mainland: hide tents and cooking fires on a green coastal plain, fields and a trading cart, the faint spires of Atlantis on the sea horizon at dusk

jumper.subject: a Puddle Jumper, the Ancients' small gate ship, flying in space just out of a Stargate whose blue event horizon glows behind it: a compact, stubby hull like a small rounded box, slab sides and a flat underside, a wide wraparound front windscreen with a centre frame, grey-green metal plating with angular panel lines, and two short cylindrical drive pods swung out on struts from the upper and lower rear flanks, glowing softly blue-white
jumper.notes: match the ship in likeness.jpg: boxy and stubby like a small bus, about twice as long as it is wide; the drive pods are short cylinders on swing-arms at the rear. No wings, no fins, no ring-shaped engines, no sleek fighter shape. Show the whole ship from a three-quarter front view

mckay.subject: Dr. Rodney McKay, the expedition's brilliant and abrasive chief scientist: short thinning hair, a black leather jacket over a dark shirt with a Canadian flag patch, an impatient, know-it-all expression, an Ancient tablet glowing in his hand, a lab behind him

teyla.subject: Teyla Emmagan, leader of the Athosians and a member of the gate team: long brown hair, a dark sleeveless top, bantos fighting sticks in her hands, a calm, perceptive expression, the gate room's amber stained glass behind her

ford.subject: Lt. Aiden Ford, a young Marine on the gate team: close-cropped hair, a black cap, a grey expedition jacket with the Atlantis patch, an eager, loyal look, a P90 at the ready

zelenka.subject: Dr. Radek Zelenka, a Czech engineer in his forties: round wire-rimmed glasses, unruly brown hair, stubble, a grey-blue expedition jacket with a Czech flag patch, a tablet in his hands, an anxious, clever expression, glowing Ancient consoles behind him
